name: Incident response
purpose: Detect, declare, mitigate, communicate and resolve a production incident, then learn from it.
trigger: An alert fires or a user report indicates degraded or unavailable service.
entry_criteria: Alert or report is available with time and scope

steps.note: Confirm the signal is real and assign severity.
Declare, mitigate and communicate; keep a timeline.

decisions.question: Is the cause a recent release?

failure_paths.action: Keep the incident open and escalate severity

exit_criteria: Service restored and SLO indicators recovered
Postmortem published with owners and due dates
Follow-up items tracked in the backlog
communication_plan: Status updates at the severity-defined cadence; final customer notice on resolution.
